notes.title: Small update and price change
notes.content:
I just made a very small update. Turns out that I forgot to add sounds to the new boss. This update adds them in but that is not the only change. If you have downloaded this DLC, you will notice that the ice is no longer slippery. That is because the code somehow got corrupted. When I went back to the ice level, for some reason, it did not react the same way as it did before. Then again, I always had trouble with the code for the ice since its very beginning. I overestimated coding this feature and in the end never got it right. That is the reason why there are only 2 stages with ice in them in the entire game. More stages were planned, including in the DLC, to have ice in the their stages but due to my inability to get it right, I had to make due with only 2. And now the code is corrupted and had no choice but to call it a lost cause and remove these feature. Now the ice performs the same as any other platform.

And with that, the game is officially finished. I won't be updating it anymore aside from some fixes that are reported but as far as development goes, the game is done. I'll have more to say later on after the 10th, which is the final day for the DLC to remain active. After the DLC is removed, the basic game will drop in price. Reviewers have praised the price for this game but to be honest, I've recently felt that it was too much, that is why I decided to lower it. So if you just want to play the game and don't care about extra content, then wait until after the 10th where the price will drop.

notes.title: DLC update and end of support
notes.content:
A new update has been created for the DLC and this one fixes a few minor issues as well as unlocks an extra mission. Also, there may be a problem with the DLC not loading correctly. If you download the expansion, make sure the Loading screen is golden in color as oppose to white, there should be a new logo, and on the title menu, in the lower right corner, the version number should be present. If you can't see any of this, please contact me.

Also, the basic version has not been updated with the expansion's fixes so it is imperative that you download the DLC as the basic version will be fixed later on. It's free so there is no real reason not to.

This DLC is only available for a limited time. By the 10th, the DLC will be removed and this game's support will finally end.

notes.title: DLC update on artwork
notes.content:
The artwork for the current expansion's cutscenes have been patched. It is no longer a flat solid color but actually complete. There's still much to do however so another patch will be made in the coming weeks.

Be sure to get this DLC by October 10th as it is limited time only. When the 10th arrives, it will no longer be available.

notes.title: DLC progress and reviews
notes.content:
I would like to thank all who have played the game and those who have reviewed it. Over the past weeks while the DLC is being developed, we have been contacting many review sites and have gotten positive feedback on the game, with the gameplay being the most praised. That's not to say we have not gotten some critiques. One of the biggest complaints is the map is hard to navigate through corridors, mainly in Clay Island. We are working on fixing this issue as well as many others that have been pointed out to us so expect an update in the near future. Overall the game has been lauded as being enjoyable and charming, and I'm thankful for everyone who has given us such honest feedback.

As for the DLC's progress, it appears that there is a lot more that is needed to add that the original expected development of 2 months will not be enough time to do so. We have to extend the time by 3 additional months and we are expecting the DLC to be finished by early September. I apologize for this delay but we are adding more content to the game that will require such a large amount of development hours. If you are wondering what will go into the DLC, here is a list of the additional features:

- A new storyline with an additional 20 extra stages strung out throughout the previous islands.
- A new island, Gold Island, with an extra boss.
- An extra storyline where you can unlock 3 more characters.
- Unlockable development extras such as concept art and trivia.
- Coin challenge where you must find every coin in every level.

There is also one more extra feature but I want to see if you guys can find it, so I hope you look forward to the DLC coming in a few months.

notes.title: Gamepad support now enabled and update on DLC progress
notes.content:
Just a quick announcement. The game has been updated to include gamepad support. You can now plug in a controller and the game will detect it. With this update, I had to add a fail safe due to being able to get stuck on the main menu if you needed to use a gamepad but did not have one. You can now revert to the default control scheme by holding F5 for 2 seconds. The button configuration menu has also been changed for ease of use. You no longer have to configure each button one by one. Now you have to press the Restart button in the menu and you will go through the entire list one by one. This is a better option due to the original setup having you edit the button with the controller but go through the menu with the keyboard. Now you only have to use the keyboard to access the menu and start the configuration process.

The DLC is now in production. I mentioned that it will take 2 months to finish it but this date is being upped by a few extra weeks. I am aiming to release this in 2 months and 2 weeks but there is no guarantee of that. All I can say is that the DLC will arrive before August comes around.
